title: 鼓励支持与积极回应
description: 自然地安慰朋友、给予鼓励并回应好消息。

data.chinese: 别灰心，你已经做得很好了。
data.english: Keep your chin up, you are doing great.
I am behind you, so go for it.
Take your time and do it one step at a time.

data.chinese: 失败一次不代表世界末日。
data.english: One setback is not the end of the world.
I knew you had it in you.

data.chinese: 你的努力终于有回报了。
data.english: All your hard work has finally paid off.

data.chinese: 听到这个消息我真替你高兴。
data.english: I am over the moon for you.
Keep it up, you have come a long way.

data.chinese: 无论发生什么，我都会陪着你。
data.english: Whatever happens, I will be there for you.

data.chinese: 先好好庆祝一下，你值得。
data.english: Take a moment to celebrate, you have earned it.
